rules.rule: Review GitHub Actions for least-privilege permissions, correct cache usage, safe secret handling, and whether CI steps match the actual Swift package build and test surface.

Review Swift package configuration for target boundaries, platform compatibility, dependency scope, test target wiring, and whether package settings match the repository's intended runtime and CI baseline.

Review app-layer Swift code for state ownership, main-thread and MainActor correctness, dependency injection clarity, and whether lifecycle code can cause hidden side effects or brittle startup behavior.

Review service-layer Swift code for async cancellation behavior, timeout and retry policy, error mapping, optional handling, and whether networking or IO boundaries leak implementation details into callers.
Review shared Swift code for force unwraps, unsafe optional assumptions, value semantics, thread-safety expectations, and whether public APIs make invalid states hard to express.
